`handoff_profiles.json` contains five fictional software regression profiles,
not real participant records or observed outcomes. It covers two complete
assessments, partial answers, the no-input study reference and a recent-use
scenario. Expected probabilities, times and explanations come from the included
frozen model. The fixture is never combined with PATH training data.

Restored `synthetic_cohort.json`, `synthetic_evaluation.json` and
`output_profiles.json` support historical research tests. Their identifiers and
answers are invented software examples, not real PATH participant records.
Historical tests opt in with `--research-tests`; some output tests also require
old private model artifacts that are not included in the handoff.
